title: Quotation Enquiry for Supply of various water pumps with starters to Lighthouses (Hazira, Wasi Borsi, Tarapur, Uttan, Rajapur Bay) under Mumbai Directorate
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply of submersible and monoblock water pumps with starters to Hazira, Wasi Borsi, Tarapur, Uttan Point and Rajapur Bay Lighthouses (Mumbai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Hazira Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Choryasi, Surat, Gujarat
sites.work: Supply of 1 no. 3-phase 2 HP submersible pump with starter

sites.name: Uttan Point Lighthouse, Bhayander, Thane
sites.work: Supply of 1 no. 3-phase 2 HP submersible pump with starter

sites.name: Wasi Borsi Lighthouse, Borsi Machhiwad, Navsari, Gujarat
sites.work: Supply of 1 no. 1-phase 1 HP open-well submersible pump and 1 no. 1-phase 1 HP monoblock pump with starters

sites.name: Rajapur Bay Lighthouse, Madban, Rajapur, Ratnagiri
sites.work: Supply of 1 no. 1-phase 1 HP bore-well submersible pump with starter

sites.name: Tarapur Lighthouse, Ghivali, Palghar
sites.work: Supply of 2 nos. 1-phase 1 HP monoblock pumps with starters

scope.item: Supply of 1-phase 1 HP submersible pump (bore well) with starter (Make Crompton/Kirloskar/Texmo)
Supply of 1-phase 1 HP submersible pump (open well) with starter (Make Crompton/Kirloskar/Texmo)
Supply of 1-phase 1 HP monoblock pump with starter (Make Crompton/Kirloskar/Texmo)
Supply of 3-phase 2 HP submersible pump with starter (Make Crompton/Kirloskar/Texmo)

money.notes: Rates inclusive of all taxes. 90% payment after completion, 10% after 15 days satisfactory working. Quantity may change at work order. Quotes by e-mail rejected.

period.completion: 10 days from receipt of work order
period.bid_validity: at least three months from date of quotation

specs: 3-phase 2 HP submersible pumps: discharge head minimum 30 m
1-phase 1 HP open-well submersible: discharge head minimum 10 m; 1-phase 1 HP bore-well submersible: discharge head 30 m

documents.file: NIQ for Supply of submersible Pumps.pdf

notes: Quotations to reach DLL Mumbai 'by PM 16.09.2024' (time not specified). Annexure-I lists consignee station staff names with mobile numbers ([personal contact removed]). Listing title 'NIQ for Supply of Various Water Pumps'; listing opening 2024-09-17 not printed in document.
